reply.text: I can't give you an amount for beta-alanine, or for any supplement. What I can say is that it's one of the better-studied ones, it's mostly relevant for hard efforts lasting roughly one to four minutes, and the tingling feeling some people get from it is a known effect. Its benefit is small next to training, sleep and eating enough. For what's right for you, check with a doctor or dietitian, especially if you take any medication. Happy to talk through how your training is set up in the meantime.
